decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while deploying efficient threats to win the game quickly. It utilizes powerful disruptive cards like Force of Will and Abrupt Decay to control the board while deploying threats like Deathrite Shaman and Leovold, Emissary of Trest to apply pressure. The deck also includes unique cards like Collector Ouphe and Psychic Frog to disrupt opponent's artifacts and creatures. By combining disruption and aggression, this deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victory in the early game.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while drawing cards and controlling the board. It utilizes powerful counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, along with disruptive cards like Fatal Push and Wasteland. Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing the player to recur key cards from the graveyard. The deck also includes card draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to maintain card advantage. Overall, the goal of this deck is to control the game through disruption and card advantage until it can secure a win condition.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Coveted Jewel alongside artifacts like Mana Vault, The One Ring, and Urza's Saga to generate a large amount of mana. By combining cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Mishra's Workshop with powerful mana rocks and artifacts, the deck aims to achieve a game-winning advantage through card advantage and explosive plays. The inclusion of powerful Vintage staples like Force of Will, Tinker, and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional control and flexibility in achieving the combo's end goal.

The main concept of this Vintage Combo-Dredge deck is to utilize cards like Serum Powder, Bazaar of Baghdad, and Golgari Grave-Troll to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Ichorid and Narcomoeba. By using efficient discard outlets and dredge cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, the deck aims to constantly put pressure on the opponent and quickly assemble game-winning combos. Key cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation provide protection and disruption, while Prized Amalgam and Creeping Chill add extra value and reach. This deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless combination of dredging and combo potential.

This deck aims to quickly establish and control the board with powerful artifacts and disruptive spells. It utilizes fast mana acceleration like Moxen and Sol Ring to cast threats like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher early on. By combining artifact synergies with powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Gitaxian Probe, the deck can assemble powerful combos with cards like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel. The inclusion of disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares helps to maintain control over the game while pressuring the opponent with aggressive threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements to disrupt opponent's strategies while generating card advantage through efficient spells. It includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Force of Will to control the game, alongside disruptive elements like Wasteland and Strip Mine. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and resilience. The deck also features a mix of proactive and reactive spells, such as Dig Through Time and Fatal Push, to effectively handle various threats and maintain control over the game.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to control the game by using cards like Force of Will, Wasteland, and Psychic Frog to counter threats and disrupt the opponent's mana base. By utilizing versatile cards like Lórien Revealed and Consign to Memory, the deck can maintain control of the board while setting up win conditions with cards like Time Vault and Ancestral Recall. Additionally, the inclusion of a companion card, Lurrus of the Dream-Den, provides extra value and recursion throughout the game.

The combo in this deck revolves around using Doomsday to set up a winning combination of cards, typically involving Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. The deck is highly focused on card selection and manipulation to ensure you have the right cards in hand to execute your combo efficiently. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect your combo from being disrupted by your opponent. Overall, the key strategy is to efficiently set up and execute your Doomsday combo to secure a victory.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on utilizing card advantage and disruption to control the game. It relies on powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Force of Will to maintain board control and protect its game plan. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional recursion of key cards, adding to its resilience in longer games. The deck also includes various disruptive elements like Strip Mine and Wasteland to disrupt opponents' mana bases. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents while controlling the pace of the game.

The deck focuses on deploying disruptive creatures that also provide additional benefits to the controller, such as taxing the opponent's spells or controlling their resources. By utilizing mana acceleration cards like Moxen and Chrome Mox, the deck aims to quickly deploy threats like Chancellor of the Annex, Archon of Emeria, and Anointed Peacekeeper to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of hatebears and aggressive creatures, the deck aims to apply pressure while also hindering the opponent's ability to effectively respond, ultimately overwhelming them with a disruptive aggro strategy.

A Vintage Combo deck that focuses on assembling the combo pieces to generate additional mana and card advantage, eventually leading to winning the game by using Coveted Jewel or other key combo pieces such as The One Ring and Paradoxical Outcome. The deck utilizes fast mana acceleration like Mishra's Workshop and Moxen, along with powerful artifacts like Tolarian Academy and Time Vault to quickly set up the combo. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Trinisphere to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck revolves around generating a lot of mana quickly to cast powerful spells and activate incredible abilities. The main goal is to assemble the Coveted Jewel and other key artifacts, such as the Time Vault combo, to gain a massive advantage over the opponent. It utilizes cards like Mystic Forge, Paradoxical Outcome, and Tinker to manipulate the deck and draw into necessary pieces. With the ability to generate significant amounts of mana and control the board with counterspells like Force of Will, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through powerful combinations and board presence.

The focus of this deck is to quickly deploy disruptive creatures such as Chancellor of the Annex and Archon of Emeria while using hate cards like Anointed Peacekeeper to slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration with cards like Black Lotus and Moxen to power out its threats ahead of schedule. The inclusion of cards like Cavern of Souls helps to ensure that the creatures can't be countered, while Strip Mine and Wasteland disrupt the opponent's mana base. This deck aims to apply early pressure and lock down the opponent's options to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures, known as hatebears, to disrupt opponents' strategies while also applying pressure with fast mana acceleration cards. By using cards like Chancellor of the Annex, Archon of Emeria, and Anointed Peacekeeper, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and control the field. Additionally, with cards like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Witch Enchanter, the deck can generate card advantage and maintain board presence. The deck is designed to be fast and disruptive, aiming to gain an advantage early in the game and secure a win.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies while deploying efficient threats and card advantage. With a mix of disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe and Deathrite Shaman, along with powerful planeswalkers like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Leovold, Emissary of Trest, the deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent. Force of Will and Force of Negation provide additional protection, while cards like Brainstorm and Dig Through Time help filter through the deck for key pieces. Aggressive yet versatile, this BUG Midrange deck is well-rounded and adaptable to various matchups in Vintage 1 vs 1.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play. It includes powerful cards like Force of Will, Show and Tell, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to maintain board control and outvalue opponents. With a mix of card draw, disruption, and ramp, the deck aims to quickly set up its win condition while disrupting the opponent's strategy. By efficiently using resources and powerful spells, this control-Oath of Druids deck aims to overpower opponents and secure victory in one-on-one Vintage matches.
